title: Type /imagine followed by a prompt

body.text: command, then type your prompt after it. Midjourney gives you 4 options, then you choose
(Variation — a similar version) of the one you like.

example: /imagine a futuristic city at night, neon lights, rain, cinematic, highly detailed

title: Try and iterate

body.text: The first image is rarely perfect. The real workflow is
try → see the result → tweak the prompt → try again
. Keep words that work, drop words that throw it off, a little at a time — you don't need a perfect prompt on the first try.

example: Image too dark → add 'bright daylight, soft lighting' and /imagine again
